g.text: Backup answers "restore yesterday". Site Recovery answers "the region is gone". Different tools.
granularity: whole VM or one file
RTO a failover, then boot time
Neither replaces the other. ASR will happily replicate a corrupted disk to the second region.
two vault facts this lab will make you meet
a Trusted Launch VM refuses a Standard policy and fails with
the sub-type cannot be changed after the policy is created
soft delete is AlwaysON, 14 days, not configurable
a vault holding only soft-deleted items can still be deleted in one pass
